archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (adapted with Brand Orange)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build the page using pure HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript in a single index.html file (or separate .css/.js).
NO REACT, NO BUILD STEP. Use Tailwind CSS via CDN (<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>) to achieve the required padding, typography, and grid systems.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use the provided Google Fonts (Outfit).
Follow the 'Generous Spacing Philosophy' (p-8, p-12, py-24).
Ensure high contrast. Use #000000 for primary text/headings, #e57119 for CTAs, highlights, and icons.
Strictly NO photos of humans. Use the provided generated image URLs and SVG icons (Lucide or Phosphor via CDN).
Incorporate infographic elements: use large numbers, visual timelines, and progress bars/stats for the Team section instead of human bios.
Implement Vanilla JS for the animated statistic counters, smooth scrolling, and mobile menu.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing and Grid-based alignment. Use Tailwind scale.
layout_and_spacing.section_padding: py-24 md:py-32 px-6 md:px-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento-style grids for features and team sections. Use gap-8 or gap-12.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #e5e7eb on cards, creating a 'Grid Borders' technical look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hover states should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with a sharp, subtle shadow (shadow-lg).
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Lucide icons via CDN (e.g., <script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest"></script>). Render them in #e57119 or #000000.
visual_enhancers.animations: Vanilla JS IntersectionObserver for simple fade-in-up entrance animations on scroll.

sections_and_components.name: Header
sections_and_components.layout: Fixed top, background white with 90% opacity and backdrop blur. Logo left, Nav center (visible on desktop), CTA button right.

sections_and_components.name: Hero
sections_and_components.layout: 2-column grid (text left, abstract graphic right). H1 with brand tagline. Subtitle. Primary CTA.

sections_and_components.name: Key Statistics (Infographic)
sections_and_components.layout: 4-column grid spanning full width. Large numbers (JS animated counters) with small overline labels. High contrast (Black background with White text and Orange numbers).

sections_and_components.name: Services (Bento Grid)
sections_and_components.layout: Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Cards for Web Design, Hosting, Maintenance, Support. Each card has a large icon, title, and 1-line description. Hover border turns orange.

sections_and_components.name: Process Timeline (Infographic)
sections_and_components.layout: Horizontal flex container with a central connecting line. Nodes for Design, Develop, Deploy, Manage, Enhance, Support. Alternating text top and bottom.

sections_and_components.name: Team Expertise (Infographic)
sections_and_components.layout: Large single-card bento box. No faces. Instead, show horizontal progress/stat bars representing the team breakdown: Graphic Design, Web Devs, QA, SEO, Marketing. Minimalist data-viz style.

sections_and_components.name: CTA Section
sections_and_components.layout: Solid #e57119 background. Large bold black text. Contact form with floating labels.

sections_and_components.name: Footer
sections_and_components.layout: Black background. Grid layout. Mention Headquarters (Memphis, TN) and Production Center (Hyderabad, India).

hero_graphic.description: Abstract 3D isometric geometric composition representing digital web design (Orange and Black)

services_graphic.description: Abstract geometric illustration representing cloud hosting and server maintenance

process_illustration.description: Abstract line-art illustration of a timeline or process flow

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form inputs) MUST include data-testid in kebab-case.
